neighbours.label: the second half of a contrast where the verb or noun is dropped ('those who did not', 'what hasn't', 'on the other')
fire: Some students passed and others did not.
Tell me what works and what doesn't.
Keep the plants that thrive and remove the ones that don't.
On the one hand it saves money; on the other, it costs time.
There are those who can and those who can't.
Some days are easy and other days are not.
Decide who should stay and who should not.
One door led out, the other in.
quiet: Some students passed the exam in June.
Tell me what time the train leaves.
Keep the plants in the sun by the window.
On Monday it rains; on Tuesday, it snows.
There are two chairs and a table in the room.
Some days are easy at the new job.
Decide who should stay at the cabin with us.
One door led out to the garden.

short: elliptical second half of a contrast
